items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update - Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: This update resolves a critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVE-2026-71362) that could lead to unauthenticated customer account takeover. Exploitation requires no existing account, administrator privileges, or user interaction.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update - Stored Cross-Site Scripting
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update - Stored Cross-Site Scripting
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Adobe Commerce B2B Security Update - Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update - Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update - Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update - Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot technique to bypass validation. Attacks have been observed on a significant percentage of stores.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update - SessionReaper (Unauthenticated RCE)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, named 'SessionReaper' by Sansec, allows customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions. Adobe released an emergency fix, and active exploitation has been observed in the wild.
